[![](https://www.recombee.com/img/testimonials/video/perlego.png)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i1cWTU4rUYA)

## Situation

* A large and diverse academic content catalog made personalized discovery increasingly difficult to deliver effectively to students and institutions
* Existing recommendation system had reliability issues and limited scalability
* Heavy engineering dependency slowed iteration and blocked broader use across teams
* Need to support multiple personalization use cases across the user journey

## Objectives

* Improve reliability and scalability of recommendations
* Enable self-serve control for product, marketing, and publisher-driven promotion
* Support personalization across key journeys, from onboarding to homepage discovery
* Increase early engagement and book-saving behavior as a driver of retention

## Solution

Recombee supports personalized content recommendations across Perlego’s digital library. Personalization influences which titles are shown across key touchpoints, from onboarding to homepage discovery, adapting in real time as users interact with the platform.

**Fast implementation across key user journeys**

A flexible recommendation setup enabled rapid deployment across the sign-up funnel and personalized homepage discovery. Self-serve capabilities reduced engineering dependency and allowed multiple teams to iterate independently across use cases.

**Reliable personalization at scale**

A robust recommendation engine ensured consistent performance across a large and diverse academic content catalog, eliminating missing or failed recommendations and improving discovery reliability.

**Context-aware recommendations from first session**

Recommendations use contextual signals such as entry points and early user behavior to deliver relevant suggestions from the first interaction, directly supporting early activation and the key behavior of book saving.

**Full control for product, marketing, and publisher-driven promotion**

A self-serve setup enables teams to manage filtering, boosting, and experimentation independently. This includes publisher boosting capabilities, allowing strategic promotion of new or priority titles within the library experience while preserving recommendation relevance.

**Analytics and performance visibility**

Built-in reporting provides visibility into recommendation performance, helping teams understand impact, track engagement and activation metrics, and continuously optimize strategies over time.

## Benefits & Results

#### Sign-Up Funnel

* **+3%** overall conversion rate
* **+283%** users saving at least 1 book
* **+477%** users saving at least 2 books
* **+375%** users saving 3+ books

#### Library Homepage

* **+44%** CTR
* **+40%** book opens
* **+90%** books saved

Recommendations are generated based on contextual signals such as the entry book page and early user intent, ensuring highly relevant suggestions from the first interaction.

As users engage, recommendations adapt based on behavioral signals and interaction history, becoming increasingly tailored to their interests.

**Key Benefits**

* Increase early activation through first-session book saves
* Improve onboarding conversion with relevant, contextual recommendations
* Strengthen long-term retention by driving early engagement behaviors

This scenario combines collaborative filtering with behavioral signals to surface relevant academic content across a large and diverse catalog, helping users continue discovery after login.

It also supports controlled content promotion through publisher boosting, enabling selected titles and new releases to be surfaced within the library experience while maintaining relevance.

**Key Benefits**

* Improve content discovery across a broad catalog
* Increase engagement through personalized browsing experiences
* Enable controlled content promotion via publisher boosting
* Drive ongoing content consumption beyond initial session entry

**Poslovi Infostud** is the leading online job search and recruitment platform in Serbia, helping job seekers discover relevant roles and enabling employers to reach qualified candidates at scale. With over 4 million monthly visits from both anonymous and registered users, delivering relevant recommendations across every stage of the job-seeking journey is central to the platform’s core mission.

## Situation

* Existing in-house recommender was functional but difficult to scale without significant engineering investment
* Recommendation development relied on rebuilding individual scenarios internally
* Recommendations needed to work for both logged-in users with interaction history and anonymous visitors with limited behavioral data
* High-intent locations, such as job detail pages and post-application thank-you pages, required relevant recommendations to increase engagement and continue the journey

## Objectives

* Support multiple recommendation scenarios, including item-to-item, user-to-item, and item-to-user recommendations
* Improve scalability and handle large traffic volumes across multiple website placements and communication channels
* Reduce engineering dependency with a self-serve admin interface for configuring recommendation logic, previewing results, monitoring performance, and managing scenarios
* Deliver relevant personalization for both logged-in and non-logged-in users

## Solution

Recombee supports personalized job discovery across Infostud’s employment platform. Recommendations adapt to different user contexts, supporting browsing, job search, and application journeys with relevant suggestions in real time.

**Full-Funnel Personalization**

A flexible recommendation setup supports multiple scenarios, including user-to-job, job-to-job, and candidate-to-job recommendations. This enables relevant discovery across key touchpoints, from browsing job listings to high-intent application stages.

**Cold-start & Anonymous Optimization**

The solution delivers relevant recommendations for both logged-in users and anonymous visitors by leveraging real-time behavioral signals. Even with limited user history, recommendations adapt to available context to surface relevant job opportunities.

**Dynamic Profile Enrichment**

Personalized experiences for returning users are powered by interaction history and profile data. By analyzing user behavior and preferences, recommendations align with individual interests and improve job discovery over time.

**Iterative Conversion Strategy**

A scalable recommendation infrastructure enables continuous optimization through testing, performance monitoring, and data-driven improvements. This supports ongoing refinement of recommendation logic to increase engagement and application conversion rates.

## Benefits & Results

* **+32%** Application conversion on job listings
* **+200%** Recommendation-to-job engagement among non-logged-in users
* **+40.3%** Thank-you page recommendation conversion
* Improved job discovery across both anonymous and logged-in user journeys
* Reduced engineering dependency with self-serve personalization management
* Faster iteration and optimization across multiple recommendation scenarios

Jobs for You

# Driving 42% Higher User Retention for a Leading Sleep and Wellness App

Sleepiest

[Content Recommendations](https://www.recombee.com/content-recommendations)

![](https://www.recombee.com/img/case-studies/sleepiest.png)

Sleepiest is one of the world's leading sleep and wellness apps, helping millions of people **fall asleep faster and improve their sleep** through personalized audio experiences.

Its growing content library includes **bedtime stories, guided meditations, sleep sounds, breathing exercises, and relaxing music**, designed to support different sleep goals and preferences.

As its catalog expanded and onboarding became increasingly sophisticated, Sleepiest needed a recommendation platform that could **deliver relevant content from a user's very first session** while adapting to rapidly evolving product experiences.

+42%

User Retention  
AI Sleep Guide

## Situation

Sleepiest offers a large and diverse library of sleep content, making **content discovery a critical part of the user experience**.

The company had previously relied on third-party recommendation solutions that struggled to **personalize content for first-time users**.

Key challenges included:

* New users received weaker recommendations due to **cold-start limitations**
* Rapid onboarding iterations conflicted with **rigid recommendation schemas**
* The team needed onboarding responses to **immediately influence recommendations**
* Developer maintenance needed to remain minimal with a **fully managed solution**

## Objectives

* **Deliver personalized recommendations** from the very first session
* **Leverage onboarding responses** to overcome cold-start challenges
* **Enable rapid schema updates** without engineering overhead
* **Personalize discovery** across multiple user journeys
* **Build AI-powered content discovery** using Semantic Search
* **Reduce operational complexity** with a managed recommendation platform

## Solution

**Cold-Start Personalization**

Unlike traditional recommendation systems that rely primarily on historical behavior, Recombee **immediately incorporates onboarding signals** into its recommendation models. This enables Sleepiest to deliver relevant content recommendations before users have established a listening history.

**Flexible Recommendation Platform**

As Sleepiest continuously evolves its onboarding flow, Recombee's **flexible API** allows new user attributes and schema changes to be introduced without disrupting recommendation performance or requiring extensive redevelopment.

**AI-Powered Content Discovery**

Sleepiest combines Recombee's recommendation engine with **Semantic Search** to power its AI Sleep Guide. Users can describe how they feel or what kind of sleep support they need, and the AI assistant retrieves **highly relevant sleep content using natural language**.

**A True Partnership**

Beyond the technology, Sleepiest valued Recombee's **proactive, hands-on support**, from implementation assistance to helping mitigate unexpected traffic spikes during DDoS attacks.

## Benefits & Results

#### AI Sleep Guide

* +42% User Retention

#### Library Homepage

* Personalized recommendations from the very first session
* Onboarding data immediately influences recommendations
* Improved discovery for new users

\* The 42% increase in user retention was measured among users interacting with the AI Sleep Guide and Semantic Search recommendations.

## Recombee’s Solution in Action

![sleepiest](https://www.recombee.com/img/case-studies/scenarios/sleepiest-1.png)

### Personalized Home Screen

Recombee combines **onboarding responses, behavioral signals, and real-time interactions**to personalize the Sleepiest home screen for every user.

Rather than presenting identical content to everyone, recommendations continuously adapt based on **users' sleep goals, preferences, and listening behavior**.

**Key Benefits**

* **Personalized recommendations** from day one
* **Better home screen engagement**
* **Continuous learning** through real-time interactions
* **Flexible personalization** as onboarding evolves

![sleepiest](https://www.recombee.com/img/case-studies/scenarios/sleepiest-2.png)

### Swipe-to-Explore Recommendations

Sleepiest uses Recombee's **Item-to-Item recommendations** to power a TikTok-style swipe-down experience for discovering new content.

As users browse bedtime stories, meditations, or sleep sounds, Recombee continuously recommends **similar content most likely to match their interests**.

**Key Benefits**

* **Seamless content exploration**
* **Personalized discovery journeys**
* **Increased engagement** with the content library
* **Reduced content dead ends**

![sleepiest](https://www.recombee.com/img/case-studies/scenarios/sleepiest-3.png)

### AI Sleep Guide

Sleepiest integrated Recombee **Semantic Search** into its AI-powered Sleep Guide.

Users simply describe how they're feeling or what kind of sleep support they need, and the AI assistant retrieves **highly relevant sleep content using natural language**.

**Key Benefits**

* **Natural language content discovery**
* **Personalized AI recommendations**
* **Faster access** to relevant sleep content
* **Foundation for future AI experiences**

![sleepiest](https://www.recombee.com/img/case-studies/scenarios/sleepiest-4.png)

### Personalized In-App Advertisements

Sleepiest also uses Recombee to personalize **in-app advertisements shown to free users before content playback**.

Rather than serving the same promotional content to everyone, Recombee selects the internal advertisements most likely to resonate with each user based on **listening history, preferences, and user attributes**.

**Key Benefits**

* **Personalized promotional experiences**
* **More relevant ads** for every user
* **Increased trial conversion opportunities**
* **Optimized using behavioral and user profile data**

Integrate Recombee (a recommendation engine) into my application.

Before writing any code, fetch and read the integration guide at https://docs.recombee.com/ai_assistant_guide.md.

Use it as your primary reference.

First, explore the codebase to understand the stack, data models, and integration points.
